rationale: The only behavioral delta is that the fixed implementation returns early when F_SECT_PER_TRACK is zero, preventing the subsequent modulo operation with a zero divisor. The Logic section does not state that zero-sector tracks are rejected, guarded, or otherwise handled; its statements about calculating sectors, placing logical sectors, skipping busy sectors, stretching sector numbers, and assigning raw-command data apply to the normal nonzero-sector path in both implementations. Omission of the zero-sector edge case is not a leak.
